name: Fundamental Theorem of System Coupling
description: Theorem establishing that the resultant system constructor RSY defines a valid system parameterization.

elements.text: The resultant system Z belongs to DSYSTEMS, verifying state, input, output, and transition/readout function conditions.
For every system coupling recipe SCR, there exists Z ∈ DSYSTEMS such that (SCR, Z) ∈ RSY.
If (SCR, Z1) ∈ RSY and (SCR, Z2) ∈ RSY, then Z1 = Z2.
